economic_hypothesis: In a causally known broad bear state, an oversold stock whose twenty-session loss is broadly synchronized with its industry is more likely to reflect market-wide forced selling than company-specific adverse information. A completed high-turnover demand ignition can then support a multi-session rebound.
conditions: causal all-market regime at signal close is BEAR
stock completed 20-session coordinate return minus PIT-industry median completed 20-session coordinate return is between -0.10 and 0.00 inclusive

threshold_rationale.industry_residual: rounded economic bounds: no more than ten percentage points of idiosyncratic underperformance and no relative outperformance

entry: first legal executable daily open strictly after the completed signal, no later than three market sessions
exit: exact accepted H20_NEXT_OPEN translation: after twenty completed market-session indices, exit at the next legal sellable open

chronology.chronological_robustness_consumed: 2019-2021; not pristine after prior feature diagnostics
